title: Assessment and gradebook
summary: Learning courses can now include quizzes and assignments, with grades released when they are ready. You can open My grades to see your released marks and feedback; instructors can export course grades as a spreadsheet.

added: Quizzes with a question bank, attempts and marking for open answers.
Assignments with file upload, feedback and late submission handling.
Grading schemes and rubrics for consistent marking.
A gradebook that calculates category and course totals, including exemptions.
Moderation and grade release so learners only see marks when they are released.
Append-only grade history, overrides with a reason, and an appeal path.
My grades: view your released grades and feedback.
Course grade CSV export for instructors and grade approvers, with formula cells escaped.
accessibility: My grades is included in the automated accessibility check on desktop and phone widths.
